content: UI pure-logic tests: bun test cannot load UI tsx modules that use @/ alias unless the nearest tsconfig has a paths block — src/ui/tsconfig.json now mirrors tsconfig.app.json's mapping. Keep pure derivation logic in <component>-logic.ts files so tests cover them without a DOM; loading a 0%-covered tsx into bun test drags the repo-wide coverage floors below the ratchet. Extensions need 'bun run ext:install' locally or their tests fail on missing deps.

Phase rail durations live behind deriveStageDurations in run-detail/run-detail-format.ts; edge fallbacks (agent_start by kind or pi state_change payload.type, reap.completed/reap_failed/reap.orphaned, reap.pr_opened, startedAt/endedAt) cover rows predating the warren-7116 stage columns, and phase-rail-logic imports those helpers rather than duplicating them. Bundle growth inside a warren run: --update refuses all writes, so per the warren-4e7a/warren-25b7 precedent hand-set only totals.raw.js to measured+HEADROOM_RAW with a dated $comment.
